name: Foreign-insider story ('I lived in Seoul for 2 years and learned what Korean women actually use')

shots.visual: Narrator to camera or over B-roll of a city street
shots.audio_text: "I lived in Seoul for two years and noticed something about the women in my office."

shots.visual: B-roll: subway, office, cafés; specific observation
shots.audio_text: "Nobody took their jewellery off. Not for the gym, not for the sauna."

shots.visual: Why: the material they wear (stainless + PVD) and the habit
shots.audio_text: One true, specific detail per line

shots.visual: Narrator back home, putting on the same kind of stack
shots.audio_text: "So I found the closest thing here."

prompts.prompt: Write a first-person insider story about [place]. Every cultural detail must be accurate, specific and respectful; no stereotypes. The product is what the narrator adopted after living there. 90 seconds.
Use licensed stock or your own travel footage of the city; no AI-generated "local people" presented as real.

qa_checklist: Hook lands in the first 1.5 s (video) or is readable at thumbnail size (static / slide 1).
Removal test: delete the product from the script. If it still makes sense, rewrite so the product is the payoff.
Matches the reference structure (same beat order and length band) before any creative twist.
Uses only real product imagery for the product; AI is for backgrounds, characters or b-roll, and is disclosed where required.
Every claim is on the brand's approved-claims list (PDP); no invented stats, reviews, doctors or customers.
Captions burned in and inside the safe zone; sound-off still understandable.
One clear CTA that matches the landing page offer.
Three hook variants delivered for the same body (test hooks, not whole new ads).
Avoid: No stereotypes or invented facts about a culture.
Avoid: The narrator must really have lived there, or present it as a character.
Avoid: Don't claim the product is from that country if it isn't.
inputs: BRAND (name, product, price, offer, audience, proof points, banned claims)
ASSETS (real product photos/video, logo, fonts, colors)
